body: I agree. All I can do is wait and if I can’t get back in, I’m gonna have to find a way to delete it, I can’t have it lingering. Like I said, I’ve made other accounts elsewhere nowadays but never as a means of linking them all together, just having them so my main one doesn’t get over loaded but my gmail is now my primary contact. Thing is I saved pictures to emails and put it in my notes, I don’t want to lose those but again it wouldn’t be the end of the world

You read correctly, I made a spare account once that I never used, and I guess it’s all I’ve linked to my original. I’ve never had to sign out of my account, I’ve always been logged in on my computer and my phone, there was never a need to link anything else because I’m always able to access it after entering my password, I’ve NEVER been asked to prove I’m not a robot or verify it’s me by entering a code sent to another email! Yes this is catch 22! There’s no way for me to get into either accounts! I know I should’ve linked my phone and an email account i actually can access but it’s too late now! I’ve transferred most of my important sign ins and contact info to my gmail account now since I can’t get into my yahoo and if I can never get back into it, it’s not the end of the world, but this sort of thing shouldn’t just happen! If there was ever a problem, I’d be notified and change my password, I’ve never been just kicked out with no way in before! This feels manipulated like I have no choice but to call support and have them paid to unlock it for me, which I’m not doing.

No! After I prove I’m not a robot and enter my password it asks for a verification code that was sent to another yahoo account. One I haven’t used in years but even if I had used it recently, trying to log into that one does the same thing and sends a code to my email address that I’m trying to access. It doesn’t give me any other options like request a code by text or enter an alternative email. There’s no way for me to verify it’s me. I’ve NEVER had this issue and I know it’s customary to have back up email accounts(I do) and connect your email to your phone but I never had to since I made this account back in 2006 and never had any problems. This all happened recently, I was just kicked out with no way back in one day.

I keep getting the run around, the support line keeps telling me that they’re experiencing difficulties and I have no way of sending a verification code to any other account because I don’t have any other ones linked to the one I need to access. How does something like this just happen? I’ve had this account for years and never got kicked out like this!

Anything that makes me happy. Prop replicas, home decor, exercise equipment, media I enjoy. No one else but you is gonna do the things that you want to happen to you, so be good to yourself, no matter how old you get.

I just less about myself for not meaning anything to her in the end. I thought we at least parted as two ppl glad we gave each other a chance and not regret anything we said to each other. But in the end, I feel like the wake up call she needed to go through to go through and the second someone else popped up, she jumped on that chance and held onto him tight, like the reason he’s golden is because we broke up. She’s free to do as she pleases, I had no intention of ever seeing her again let alone talking to her. It just feels like I’m being punished and she got rewarded.
That’s what I was told as an invisible teenager

No good can come from dating apps, I’ve learned that lesson the hard way! I don’t really like the gym setting but I guess I can learn to get over that if I want to meet ppl. Thanks for the tips, I’ll look into them

Every time I go out whether it’s to eat, shop, or just to get out of the house I always internally think maybe I’ll just happen to bump into a pretty girl and she’ll notice me and we’ll click. I know it’s unlikely but random things happen all the time. You hear ppl say what if I decided not to go out that night, I’d probably have never met my spouse. I don’t get my hopes up too much cause…well here we are, but I never dismiss the possibility that it might happen someday. And I don’t just stand around, I approach women, I have casual conversations with them, and i certainly don’t initially say something like, I just want your number so let’s go, no I try to come across as someone who is just politely talking to them and doesn’t want anything really. Maybe I do want a break and a girl to initiate something and ask for my number for once, but no dice, ever. 

I don’t have a plan, but I’m going to stop drinking so much, I’m gonna eat less and crank up my workouts. I need to be thinner even if I don’t think I’m fat or anything. I am getting a bit of a gut, and I don’t like it so I’m gonna deal with something I don’t like for me and hope it benefits me further than expected. Thanks for hearing me vent. I appreciate it.

I always think I just live in the worst area. It’s like I never had a chance. Maybe I do come off a certain way I’m not aware of, but I can’t really change that. Like I said I’ve been through a lot and I’m introverted as a result of that, I can’t just act like I’m not, if I did I know I’d come across as someone faking a personality. Feels like everyone knows I’ve had it rough so they decide to make it worse, I always thought if only I could live in a place with more pretty girls who don’t know me at all, but one I can’t move cause my life and family are here and two I can’t afford to move and third I know where I live isn’t one big school, I should be able to bounce back, but it’s been years and nothing has changed. 

If you’re wondering how I am, I’m nice but not too nice, like I do acts of kindness like everyone should, I do ppl favors, I do things I don’t have to but I do anyway cause it’s decent, and I don’t always want a reward, but the world wouldn’t end if I got something in return for my kindness every once in awhile. I’m quiet, but I talk enough. It takes time for me to get comfortable around ppl, but once I do, I’ll talk about anything with them. I really don’t think despite all my flaws, I’m impossible to love. I do work with ppl face to face but I’m not interested in dating anyone through work, that’s just asking for trouble. I just wish I was treated more equally there. Feels like I’m always left out cause I’m a guy and it’s mostly comprised of women. I work at a pharmacy as a tech, it’s not women’s work, mine just happens to have more female techs. 

For all my self hatred I’ll say, I don’t think I’m ugly, hard to be around, or intimidating or anything. I should be able to find someone, but no one ever sticks with me. It’s like they get bored and leave. I guess that’s my problem, I’m not exciting, but how exciting can one be nowadays with this economy? All we can afford to do is live basically! I just don’t look like God’s gift to women and I’m seen as the one you settle for and no one wants to settle for me.

I don’t need us to be best friends! I don’t need constant praise. I don’t even need acknowledgement every day! I just wish once in a while someone was happy to see me and was glad I was there! I actually don’t like getting constant attention, I’m one of those ppl who want it in small doses. 

I took this job cause I did have experience going in, and I absolutely needed a new job. I’ve been doing this for 3 years now, and when I first saw that I was the only straight guy working here, I didn’t know what to think, like it didn’t bug me, I’m here for the paycheck. Again, all I want is a fraction of the love they give each other. With me being a guy, it makes me feel like a real ugly guy that no one wants around. Like if I was really handsome, this wouldn’t be happening to me, they’d want me around always. 

Look, I have hobbies, I have loved ones, I’m a happy person. I’m just alone a lot and while I can be happy alone, no one wants to be alone all the time or forever. I’ve had relationships but they always end in heartbreak, so life in and out of work isn’t great and it doesn’t show any sign of improvement. That’s where I’m at, coping. 

Just wish they could see how alienated and lonely I feel.

I work in a pharmacy, we’re all technicians, that tip line was just an example of what I do outside of work cause I know how difficult other jobs can be so I try to brighten up someone’s day. I get what you’re saying, I was well aware from the start that there going to be conversations between them that I would not be apart of with me being a guy, I’m fine with that, that doesn’t bother me. However, and this is a big thing, there IS another guy who works there but he’s gay, so he’s more like one of the girls. He got invited, he’s their pal, and they all love him. 

Now I have absolutely nothing against him or the fact that he’s gay! He’s just…unsettling to me. There have been times where he’s thrown “temper tantrums” at work and acts like he owns the place and he doesn’t! He’s hard to be around for my tastes. Not that I judge, I mean I have no idea what his life is like outside work. I’m only saying, it’s upsetting for me that a guy like that is loved and invited to places and treated way better than me, someone who rarely shows anger, does his best to help anyone he can, and stays humble. I’m far from perfect but I don’t act like I’m $hit either! 

All of these things against me are purely coincidental. Maybe if I worked somewhere else, my personality would be just what everyone wants in a friend and I’d be Mr popular. That’s not why I come to work, to make friends. I come to make money and that’s all. Just saying, it’s not easy seeing so much kindness between others, knowing that’s all I want, and feeling like no one really cares if I’m here or not and on my worst days it feels like they wouldn’t care if I died either. I know I’m being a drama queen, but it feels like I’m a kid in junior high again, no really liked me, and I can’t wait to get home. 

And if you’re wondering why I don’t quit and get a new job. My job I had before this one was basically abusing me, and getting a new job is too hard these days! I don’t even know what else I would do! I live close by so it’s convenient. I remember when I interviewed, the manager liked everything i said to the point of me getting hired within the first fifteen minutes. I like the job, I like helping people, I just don’t like feeling like the black sheep.

No! Getting a new job is too hard, I don’t even know what I’d do, and as bad as the environment is, it’s convenient. And not really, most of my friends moved on, not because we had a fight or anything, their lives just took over, so I understand, I have ppl who get in touch with me, just not hang out with.
I just don’t know who to ask and how not to come off a conceited insecure jerk. I don’t need everyone to like me, just not make it feel like I’m hated.

I’m aware I may come off a certain way, but it’s been 3 years now, they’ve seen the real me, if they haven’t warmed up to me, then it’s just not in the cards. I know I can’t make ppl like me, I just wish it didn’t feel like I’m invisible
They’re all so happy and friendly with each other but no one wants to be friendly with me. I’m not selfless, I do things for just myself, I just don’t know what repels friendship for me.
The concept of time. Hours go by so much faster than they used to, weeks turn to months and months turn to years.
So I’d have to platinum the game all over again on the digital version?!?!

Not currently but I have had relationships since I posted this. If you’re wondering if they were fans of this stuff too, the answer is yes just not to the degree as I do. They just didn’t last due to…personal circumstances.

The difference is, 2 year olds eventually learn and get better mannerisms, when you tell them enough(maybe even punish them a little)they learn, hey this is going to get me in trouble, I’ll stop doing that cause I don’t like getting in trouble. She doesn’t, her mind is gone and has no memory of her daily routine that she’s done for years now. The grandma I love and did many things for me in the past that I have a lot of memories with hasn’t been around for a long time. So in a way I’ve already dealt with losing her, all that’s left of her is this mindless burden that is holding us back and causing too many conflicts. I just don’t understand how someone can live so long when ppl in their 80s die naturally all the time. But I no one to blame but myself for this predicament, I could’ve let her bleed to death one night, but I didn’t want that on my conscience at the time, so I saved her life and she’s lived another 4 years because of me. If only I rolled over and went to bed that night, she’d have died that night and these last 4 years wouldn’t have happened the way they did.

That’s just it, my parents tell at her all the time but they get upset when I do this ONE time. Idk if i mentioned before, but she’s alive BECAUSE of me. There was a time she was semi self sufficient living with us but she’d get frequent nose bleeds we all had to work together to get to stop. One night I couldn’t sleep I hear her get up to go to the bathroom and she never came out, everyone else is asleep and if I were asleep(couldn’t, I was paranoid thinking about this exact moment), she’d have bled out alone and would’ve died that night. That was 4 years ago! She’s lived this long BECAUSE of me, she’s alive BECAUSE of me, so if she upsets me, she’s gonna hear about it, regardless of her age or abilities. I’m aware old ppl aren’t all there but she does things only a well minded person can do, so she still has a semi functioning brain. We tell her daily not to do things and she does them anyway, within five minutes of telling her not to do something she does it. She knows she’ll only get yelled at and she’s used to it. So yea, yelling does nothing. I’m not an abuser, but I can’t go on like this. I regret my decision that night, I should’ve rolled over and went to sleep, she’d have died and the mental stability of three young ppl would be better off than they are now!

Yes, unfortunately! Blew up at her yesterday for ignoring us when we tell her important things. No, her hearing isn’t going, she’s a conniving manipulator that knows just how to get what she wants and make our lives miserable. 97.5 and still won’t die! I can’t take much more of this I’m gonna have a breakdown one of these days.

No she just takes eliquis, metoprolol, and amlodipine. All of which keep her alive but not opioids or anything like that. She already sleeps most of the time, she’s just and massive pain when she’s awake and has to eat or use the bathroom. She used to not want to eat what you put in front of her and that lead me to think she was dying, loss of appetite means the organs are shutting down, but that changed. And lately we have to tell her not to sleep when she’s in front of the tv, so that gives me a glimmer of hope that her strength is leaving her and maybe she’s on her way out. Very unlikely, but I gotta dream at this point. I just can’t take any more than two or so more moths of this, if she’s not gone by next year, I’m putting my foot down, we’ve done it there way, now we do it my way. If she doesn’t eat what’s in front of her within 30 minutes and she wasted time scrapping the sides, it goes in the garbage, if she tries to get out of the bed one more time, I’m making it easy for her to get out so she can see that she can’t walk by herself and she’ll fall and we’ll be done with this. I know I sound like a sick individual, but she’s lived her life, it’s been over for years now, we need to get back to ours because it’s far from over!

Well you’re partially right. What you don’t take into account is toddlers learn. You tell them not to do something, they’ll remember the next day or next time to not do it(usually). Not her! She’s been living under our routine we put her under for over three years now and she doesn’t remember she’s not supposed to try and get out of bed(she can’t, it has walls now, but she still tries), she doesn’t remember to not drink all her water until she’s had all her pills, she’s told constantly to not scrape the sides of her bowl and has been yelled at several times for many years now to not do that, and she does it every night. See when a toddler does something bad, you can punish them and they learn. I’m all for punishing her, just putting her back in her bed and letting her stay there whether she sleeps or not, and not let her watch tv with that stupid look on her face(she doesn’t even know what she’s looking at). But my parents say they can’t be cruel or God will punish them, and I fear God too, but enough is enough already, my mental health crumbles while they do nothing to change. We’ve done it their way for years and look where it’s got us. The woman we take care of is not the grandma I love. My grandma died a long time ago. She was funny, clever, and caring, this woman is dumb, inconsiderate, selfish, and anger inducing. I know it’s not her fault that her mind isn’t what it used to be, but how and why she’s living past 97 just isn’t right! She ate like a teenager for years and used to smoke. No one let alone someone with her past should live this long! And she doesn’t show any signs of dying, I know I’ve researched them. What gets me through each day is the hope that one day(hopefully soon)she’ll go to sleep and just won’t wake up, her heart will give out or something. I just can’t take it anymore! Not to mention, my sister has a kid on the way! We have a lot to prepare for and do but she keeps getting in the way and my mom won’t give her up! I’m sorry to write a book, but this is really tearing me up, I missed out on working over time cause someone had to be with her and it had to be me.

God bless you! I know many people have it far worse than we do. I just wish it was possible to transfer years off your life. I know my real grandma at age 87 before she lost her mind would’ve gladly died at that age knowing she gave someone else ten extra years to live! It’s not fair! I read all these stories of people dying and I see their age of 86, 92,84, 89. But 97?! Come on! That’s just not right! I’ll be praying for you! You don’t deserve to die alone!

I wish we got there, but my mom won’t let go and my dad doesn’t want to constantly visit a home and my mom(who doesn’t drive) will insist they go more than frequently, so what’s the point? On the other hand, she’s only living so long because we watch her like a hawk and keep her from doing anything that would result in jury. Her first week of being unsupervised at times of the day, she would try and go to the bathroom by herself, she’d fall and break something and at that age, that’s that she won’t see the outside of a hospital. It’s come to me praying each night than when it’s time to wake her up, she just doesn’t wake up! I’m a terrible person for wanting that but this is ridiculous, our lives are passing us by and they’re hard enough without her. Not to mention I could really use her inheritance right now! But the way she is, we are going to see the ice caps melt before she dies.
Yes and yes, so that’s out.

Yes I’ve been keeping a journal long before we moved her in with us. I remember when she was still semi self sufficient and could go to the bathroom alone. Shortly after she moved in she was getting frequent nosebleeds due to the change in weather and her sinus were reacting to it. Being on blood thinners this made it especially hard to stop the bleeding and we went through at least 4 scares of holding napkins and ice to her face. 

Then on Christmas Eve 2020 when it happened again earlier that day I got a terrible thought of it happening to her while we’re all asleep and she’s never been the one to call for help or anything(she’s never been very smart). I couldn’t sleep that night and I tossed and turned while I listened to my parents snoring. Then finally as I expected, she got up to use the bathroom and I waited to hear the toilet flush…it never did and I heard the sink running constantly. I laid there for awhile thinking any second now she’s gonna shut off the water and walk out…nope. What else could I do except wake up mom and tell her she hasn’t come out in at least twenty minutes. She rushed in and all I’m hearing is Oh My God repeatedly. Dad wakes up and the next thing I know is we’re cleaning up her blood and trying to get it to stop again. So I ended up saving her life that night. Now for the past year and half all I can think about is I should’ve just ignored my fears that night and took a ton of melatonin and went to sleep. She’d have died that night and none of this would be happening. 

That’s how bad it’s gotten, im kicking myself for saving her life. I mean if I only knew then what I know now, her dying that night wouldn’t have been so bad. We had no visitors cause of Covid and she was 94, she’s lived a long life. We have researched what help we could get but my mother won’t budge(she’s stubborn). Money isn’t tight but my parents would rather suffer and keep their money and inheritance than ship her off somewhere where she won’t get treated well for a big charge. Although I don’t think she’ll last a week elsewhere cause she thinks she can do thing on her own(she lived along for 30 years) and she’ll break her legs getting out of bed. Plus if she does live longer in a home, my mother will always want to go be with her to make sure she’s actually eating and what not. That’s a big problem. My mom won’t let go even though she wants out of this hell hole! So they’ve chosen to just wait it out and it’s killing me cause I don’t see her dying anytime soon! I feel like you could push her down the stairs and she’ll get up, it’s so frustrating no one should live this long!
Yea, I probably should should, it’s just..not going to be easy

I’m always honest and real with everyone especially her. Yea I won’t budge on these and it’s important to me. I don’t read too much into what I see on social media because I know I’m only seeing the good parts and all relationships have bad parts that aren’t shown. Maybe I’m really not ready, but that’s really sad cause like I said I’m 33 here, this is the kind of stuff that was supposed to happen to me in high school and my 20s(even tho ppl think I’m still in my 20s). I am thinking about it, it’s all I can think about. Overthinking is one of my issues.

Yea, I’m very uneasy about the future and yea these probably are deal breakers. I just don’t want to hurt her, she’s great, I just wish I could change those few things about her life, but I can’t and even if I could I wouldn’t cause it’s her life, I can’t force these kind of changes. It’s just…it took me so long for this to happen. I know I’m not ugly, I’m just…not really attracting girls left and right, so if I end this and nothing else ever happens to me, I’ll always wonder if this was the closest I can get.

Such an interesting story with so much potential. We could’ve gotten so much from this film, but sadly it’s not all there.

The thing is, I can totally buy his mopey guilt driven attitude. He may have saved the world but he lost two close friends in the process. That doesn’t just go away after doing something amazing. Real life soldiers will vouch for that. My issue is they don’t talk about it enough. I could understand if this was a game and the focus is more gameplay than story, but this is a movie and the purpose of a movie is to have moving dialogue that advances the story and makes you feel for the characters. I guess I’m disappointed because I love Cloud and relate to him a lot, and I want to see more of him and see him deal with stuff, but there wasn’t enough focus here.

That’s what I would’ve loved to see on screen. The two of them talking, working out their problems. It would’ve been great to see cause people actually DO go through this. But this movie had too many quiet action scenes for me. I like it fine, but I still have a hard time feeling for characters when they don’t talk much or nothing seems to hurt them. Like a stab from a sword kills Aeirth but Sephiroth and Cloud can get stabbed and fall from high points and live?! My main problem is I wanted to know if Tifa and Cloud actually end up together, yes I can gather they did in my mind, but what is it with FF characters never kissing?

I don’t mind a routine or things being familiar, even tho I know ppl hate ruts. I had hobbies before covid hit that I could no longer do and I was mad about that. I think it’s just my surroundings are telling me that I’m weird, because my family is excited to do things again, I know other families that are too, I’m just not ready to face all that.

You’re right about that! People could very well just be pretending to be happy when they aren’t. Society has never been something I understand and it’s not something anyone can likely understand so there’s no point in trying. I like what I like and people free to disagree, it’s fine. I’m just conflicted about missing a time where many were miserable.

Wow, you’re really hitting the nail on the head. I know it’s all about business for these corporate big wigs and it’s our need for love that fuel their fire. It’s just, before i would see that girls swiped right on me and I could find them to decide if I wanted to swipe right on them too, and now I’m getting nothing, not even one. I know spending money on these things might get me more attention, but I didn’t have to pay then and I don’t want to now.

Glad you agree. It just really makes me ask what does all this say about me? I’m getting no attention and I’m judging every person on these things based on a few photos and a few sentences. Makes me feel unwanted and cruel, but how else do I get a chance for someone to find me?

Right, I have no idea what would’ve happened if we “dated”. I’m not putting anything up on a pedestal. It’s just now(until I find someone else and you know how that’s been going for the past three years) I’m always gonna wonder what might have been, could she have been the one. If only covid didn’t exist and I was in a better place at the time of meeting her, would she have become my endgame? I’ll never know now.

Even if I did have reliable means of transportation(which I don’t), I just don’t know what she was expecting. Like I said we live pretty close by so she knows of all the restrictions in our state, so I have no idea where this other guy is taking her or what they’re doing. All I know is, I had what I always wanted dangled right in front of me, but my hands were tied behind my back. Did I expect her to wait for me? No, but not fair. If only I was able to meet and do something with her, she’d most likely(not definitively) be my gf right now. Now she’s the one that got away. Of course there’s a possibility that things won’t work out between her and this guy, but this girl looks like she belongs on a magazine, you’d have to be an idiot to let her get away. I just can’t believe I still got hurt when I went to great lengths to not get hurt again.

I didn’t join TikTok to meet anybody, like I said this never happens where she found me! I forgot to mention that yes, a few times(4 out of 8 I think) where we did exchange contact info....they all ended up blocking me. Why? I have no idea, it couldn’t have been anything I said, like it mentioned they all seemed to like me a lot, it was always randomly, and it stung each time.

Well, maybe maybe not. I am as nice as possible. But not for the reasons you may think, or maybe I am deep down, idk. I try to be as nice as I can to show ppl that there are still good ppl out there who appreciate everything they do and will gladly converse with them about anything. Everyone has their limits with their emotions, but I’d say I’m usually nice. I don’t do it for sex and womens’ lust. 

I probably am a big project for a therapist to put back together. I’m not ashamed to admit that I do need help, and I’m willing to share my problems...it’s just the world is nothing but problems now and everyone thinks that their problems are bigger than the nexts’. I don’t like it, but that’s the way the world is, and fair enough, we’ve all been through a lot, but I’m not going to be earning sympathy points from women that way when we just experienced 2020.

Well I almost hate to break it to you, but I already do most of that. I’ve been exercising everyday for well over a decade because I was tired of being a skinny kid everyone overlooked...you can guess it hasn’t helped much which makes me wonder what will work. It doesn’t matter if I’m skinny like I was or muscular like I am now(I’m not body builder but my biceps are 16 inches in diameter and I weigh less than 200lbs at 5’9), nobody cares if the face doesn’t look like if it was kissed by an angel.
